d: China’s ambassador to the Philippines, Jing Quan, sparks a diplomatic storm by claiming Beijing could “easily win” a war against Manila, prompting a reaction from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Meanwhile, Donald Trump’s Truth Social faces a growing crisis as user engagement reportedly declines and financial losses mount. As tensions rise in the South China Sea and the US midterm elections approach, Firstpost examines the diplomatic fallout of China’s latest threat and asks whether Trump’s digital megaphone is losing its reach. Hem Kaur Saroya explains.
